# 9 blueberry alternatives to try without compromising on nutrients

## Why is everyone talking about blueberries?

Blueberry is a powerhouse of nutrients like vitamin C, vitamin K, manganese and fiber. Known for boosting brain health, supporting heart health, and reducing inflammation, blueberries are a delicious and versatile addition to any diet.

Getty Images

## If you don't have access to blueberries, here are a few alternative

Blueberries are nutrient-packed superfoods. They are an excellent source of vitamin C, vitamin K, manganese, and fiber. However if you don't have access to fresh blueberries, here are a few alternatives you can try.

## Orange

Oranges are rich in vitamin C, providing over 70% of the daily requirement in one medium fruit. They also contain fiber, potassium, folate, and antioxidants like flavonoids. Low in calories, oranges support immune health, heart function, and digestion while promoting healthy skin and reducing inflammation.

Getty Images

## Guava

Guavas are nutrient-dense fruits, rich in vitamin C , fiber, potassium, and folate. They also contain vitamin A, magnesium, and antioxidants like lycopene. Guavas support immunity, digestion, heart health, and skin health, making them a powerful addition to a balanced diet.

Getty Images

## Pineapple

Pineapple is rich in fiber. Just one cup of pineapple can meet 10% of the daily needs of fiber requirement.

## How To Substitute Frozen Blueberries For Fresh

Some great tips on how To Substitute Frozen Blueberries For Fresh Blueberries

### Instructions

Take the desired measurement of frozen blueberries and run the them under cold water a few times. At first the water will be very purple. Continue to rinse until the water nearly runs clear.

Then you’ll dry the berries with a couple of layers of paper towels (for best results dry the top and bottom of the berries). [...] This process only takes a matter of a few minutes. Once you’ve rinsed and dried your berries you are ready to add them to your batter! Be gentle in stirring, the berries will be fragile. Mix well. You know your done if your batter begins to turn blue-ish purple (that’s what you are trying to avoid).

There you have it! An easy way to substitute frozen blueberries for fresh!
